ns2:section.sectionText: MUST CHOOSE 2 or 4 credit hours. For 4 credits, students will complete 5 assignments, including a 20+ entry Future File collection of stories for future storytelling. For 2 credits, students will complete all assignments except the Future File. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Illinois Informatics Institute or Information Sciences department.
